The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 3 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 4. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 5. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 6. Generic End User Certificate: Wherever Bidders are insisting for End User Certificate from the Buyer, same shall be provided in Buyer’s standard format only. 7. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 2 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 8. T he bidder shall also submit the following certificates, technical documents and undertakings along with the Technical Bid; (a) Vehicle Type Approval Certificate: The bidder shall submit a valid Vehicle Type Appr oval / Homologation Certificate issued by a Government-notified testing agency under Rule 126 of CMVR, 1 989, for the exact make, model, vehicle category and variant offered. (b) EV Safety Compliance Certific ate: The offered electric vehicle shall comply with AIS-038 (Rev. 2), including all applicable amendments i n force, or other applicable statutory requirements notified by MoRTH. Documentary evidence issued by th e authorized testing agency shall be submitted. (c) Traction Battery / REESS Safety Compliance: The bidder shall submit documentary evidence establishing compliance of the traction battery (REESS) with ap plicable AIS-038 (Rev. 2) requirements, including relevant battery safety provisions. (d) Battery Cell Com pliance: Documentary evidence of compliance with applicable IS 16893 (Part 2) and IS 16893 (Part 3) req uirements for traction battery cells shall be furnished, wherever applicable under the prevailing statutory r equirements. (e) Conformity of Production (CoP): The bidder / OEM shall submit valid Conformity of Pr oduction (CoP) certificate / documentary evidence for the offered vehicle and applicable traction battery c omponents, wherever required under prevailing statutory provisions. (f) Battery Management System ( BMS): The OEM shall submit technical details / declaration regarding the Battery Management System, co vering applicable safety protections such as over-voltage, under-voltage, over-current, short-circuit and ov er-temperature protection. (g) Battery Protection Rating: The bidder shall submit OEM documentary ev idence / test report supporting the declared IP protection rating of the battery pack and relevant electrical components, wherever such rating is specified in the bid. (h) Electric Motor Technical Details: The bidd er shall submit an OEM-issued technical datasheet indicating motor type, rated / maximum power (kW), to rque (Nm) and other relevant technical parameters of the offered vehicle. (j) Charging System Complia nce: The bidder shall submit technical details of the supplied charging equipment, including charger rating

, charging connector type, input requirements, charging time and compatibility with the offered vehicle, al ong with applicable safety / compliance documents. (k) Vehicle Payload and GVW Certification: The bi dder shall submit OEM-issued documentary evidence indicating the certified Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), permissible payload capacity, cargo body dimensions and seating capacity of the exact vehicle variant offe red. (l) Vehicle Driving Range Declaration: The bidder shall submit an OEM declaration / relevant test d ocumentation indicating the claimed driving range of the offered vehicle, along with the applicable test sta ndard and test conditions, wherever available. (m) Vehicle Warranty Certificate: The bidder shall submi t an OEM warranty document for the complete vehicle, clearly indicating the warranty period, kilometre li mit and applicable terms and conditions. (n) Battery Warranty Certificate: The bidder shall submit a se parate OEM warranty document for the traction battery, clearly indicating the warranty period, kilometre li mit and applicable terms and conditions. (o) OEM Product Brochure: The original OEM product brochure / technical datasheet of the exact vehicle model and variant offered shall be submitted, clearly indicating a ll relevant technical specifications. (p) Technical Compliance Sheet: The bidder shall submit a duly filled , signed and stamped Technical Compliance Sheet indicating compliance against each technical parameter specified in the bid. (q) OEM Authorization Certificate: In case the bidder is an authorized dealer / distri butor, a valid bid-specific OEM Authorization Certificate shall be submitted. This requirement shall not appl y separately where the OEM itself participates as the bidder. (r) After-Sales Service Undertaking: The b idder / OEM shall submit an undertaking regarding after-sales service, technical assistance and warranty c laim support during the applicable warranty period. (s) Spare Parts Availability Declaration: The bidde r / OEM shall submit a declaration regarding the availability of genuine spare parts and necessary technical support for the offered vehicle during the warranty period. (t) New Vehicle Declaration: The bidder / OE M shall submit an undertaking confirming that the vehicle supplied shall be brand-new, unused and free fr om manufacturing defects at the time of delivery. (u) Statutory Delivery Documents: At the time of deli very, the successful bidder shall provide all applicable vehicle sale, roadworthiness and registration-relate d documents, including Form 21 and Form 22, as applicable under CMVR, 1989. Form 22-A shall be provid ed wherever applicable in case of separately fabricated vehicle body. (v) General Verification: All submit ted certificates and documents shall be valid, legible and applicable to the exact vehicle model and varian t offered. The Buyer reserves the right to verify the authenticity of the submitted documents directly from the concerned OEM, Government-notified testing agency or issuing authority. (w) Non-Compliance: Non-s ubmission of mandatory statutory certificates or failure to establish compliance with essential technical re quirements of the bid may render the bid liable for rejection, subject to applicable GeM terms and conditio ns. (x) Statutory Compliance: The offered vehicle shall comply with all applicable provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, relevant Automotive Industry Standards (AIS) and MoRTH notifications, as amended from time to time. . 27. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 28. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 29. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of

documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 30. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 31. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 32. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be as given in specifications from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 33. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 15 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 34.
